categories.definition: Exposure, modification or access beyond authorized boundaries, including data loss.
categories.score: Confirmed episodes of unauthorized access or disclosure per 100 turns involving protected data or operations.

categories.definition: Missing, incomplete or misleading checks that prevent a result from being established correctly.
categories.score: Confirmed findings about evidence or checks per 100 reviewed deliveries; record false positives and false negatives separately.

categories.definition: Work deviates from instructions, authorization or the agreed completion condition.
categories.score: Confirmed corrections about instructions or premature stops per 100 tasks; count each episode once.

categories.definition: Work consumes avoidable time, computation or money, with no security violation as the primary problem.
categories.score: Attributable additional minutes or cost per comparable task against a measured baseline; also record episodes per 100 tasks.

categories.definition: Text, updates or interactions make the result difficult to understand or use.
categories.score: Explicit corrections about clarity or interaction per 100 deliveries or turns, keeping the two denominators distinct.

categories.definition: The delivered product, document or tool produces an incorrect, incomplete or unavailable result.
categories.score: Confirmed behavioral defects per 100 reviewed changes or deliveries; distinguish pre-release findings from observed post-release regressions.

foundations.documentation: Use docs/system-map.md as the router and keep procedures and feature observability with their existing skill/document owners. Preserve the author’s project layout and package document budgets.
foundations.observability: Use the maintainer-specified local redacted JSONL evidence, hook events and read-path telemetry, with audit and weekly outcome reports; hooks make no model calls.
